target.title: Level, zone and rarity
target.content: Pick your battlefield level and the zone you attack, once per war, then the defenders' rarity. Your units show capped at that rarity, and attacks are logged there.

summary.title: Your war
summary.content: Tokens used of this war's attempts, units you still have per rarity, and attacks won and lost.

teams.title: Offense teams
teams.content: Your War Offense teams: ready ones first, then the ones blocked by a unit that already attacked.

units.title: Available units
units.content: Your units that have not attacked in this war, capped at the defenders' rarity. Tap units or a team's Select, then Won or Lost to log the attack.

log.title: Attack log
log.content: Every attack of this war, newest first. Edit changes its details; Delete removes it and frees its units.

totals.title: Totals
totals.content: Your attacks, won and lost; win rates by zone tier, zone and defender rarity; your most used characters and lineups; and the enemies you lost to most, across the wars loaded below.

wars.title: Past wars
wars.content: Your ended wars, newest first. Open one to see its attacks.
